sources.snippet: LiteRT (Google AI Edge LiteRT) is the evolution of TensorFlow Lite, designed for on-device machine learning inference. It provides optimized runtime performance for mobile and embedded devices, supporting various hardware acceleration options including CPU, GPU, and specialized neural processing units (NPUs).
